description: A test script for verifying Git behavior regarding cloning, fetching, and remote repository interactions, specifically focusing on promisor remotes and lazy fetching behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific conditions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, for validation purposes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in command output for validation.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given file or directory path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with the given content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
